interaction_requests.title.description: Title of the settings page, and its menu item, that lists the replies, boosts, and quotes of the user's posts that wait for the user's approval.

interaction_requests.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of approval requests.

interaction_requests.empty.description.defaultMessage: Antworten, Boosts und Zitate deiner Beiträge, die auf deine Genehmigung warten, erscheinen hier.
interaction_requests.empty.description.description: Description of the empty list of approval requests.

interaction_requests.kind.reply.description: Under the account in an approval request for a reply.

interaction_requests.kind.announce.description: Under the account in an approval request for a boost.

interaction_requests.kind.quote.description: Under the account in an approval request for a quote.

interaction_requests.interacting.reply.description: Accessible name of the box of the reply that waits for the user's approval.

interaction_requests.interacting.quote.description: Accessible name of the box of the post that quotes the user's post and waits for the approval.

interaction_requests.own_post.description: Accessible name of the box of the user's post that an approval request is about.

interaction_requests.accept.description: Button of an approval request that approves the reply, boost, or quote.

interaction_requests.reject.description: Button of an approval request that refuses the reply, boost, or quote.

interaction_requests.accepted.reply.description: Announced after the user approved a reply. {name} is the display name, or the username, of its author.

interaction_requests.accepted.announce.description: Announced after the user approved a boost. {name} is the display name, or the username, of the booster.

interaction_requests.accepted.quote.description: Announced after the user approved a quote. {name} is the display name, or the username, of the quoting author.

interaction_requests.rejected.reply.description: Announced after the user refused a reply. {name} is the display name, or the username, of its author.

interaction_requests.rejected.announce.description: Announced after the user refused a boost. {name} is the display name, or the username, of the booster.

interaction_requests.rejected.quote.description: Announced after the user refused a quote. {name} is the display name, or the username, of the quoting author.
